title: Version 17.14.9
body_markdown:
*Released July 15th, 2025*

| Top bug fixes | From the community |
| --- | --- |
| GitHub Copilot Agent Preview can't run terminal commands after running unit tests | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/GitHub-Copilot-Agent-Preview-cant-run-t/10913201) |
| Copilot file changes preview is empty | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Copilot-file-changes-preview-is-empty/10896553) |
| Escape key doesn't close the find box in a XAML file | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Escape-key-doesnt-close-the-find-box-in/10903175) |
| Fixed listing Android debug targets when there is an invalid Java executable in the PATH. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/visual-studio-does-not-see-detect-the-co/10888076) |
| Extension update in VS 17.14 | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Extension-update-in-VS-1714/10904555) |
| Removed filtering on C++ #include completions so that full lists are shown when both typing angle brackets and quotes. | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/include-completion-not-completely-fixed/10916416) |
| AI, Copilot, Agents and MCP - .mcp.json dotnet run command cannot make use of relative pathing | [Feedback ticket](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/AI-Copilot-Agents-and-MCP---mcpjson-/10920885) |
| Improved user experience when provisioning a Function App using Flex Consumption by removing the option to create a Linux Consumption Function App within Visual Studio. |  |
| Fixed issues where customers would need to close StandardCollector.Service.exe during installs and updates. |  |

---

Released July 15th, 2025

Top bug fixes From the community
GitHub Copilot Agent Preview can't run terminal commands after running unit tests Feedback ticket
Copilot file changes preview is empty Feedback ticket
Escape key doesn't close the find box in a XAML file Feedback ticket
Fixed listing Android debug targets when there is an invalid Java executable in the PATH. Feedback ticket
Extension update in VS 17.14 Feedback ticket
Removed filtering on C++ #include completions so that full lists are shown when both typing angle brackets and quotes. Feedback ticket
AI, Copilot, Agents and MCP - .mcp.json dotnet run command cannot make use of relative pathing Feedback ticket
Improved user experience when provisioning a Function App using Flex Consumption by removing the option to create a Linux Consumption Function App within Visual Studio.
Fixed issues where customers would need to close StandardCollector.Service.exe during installs and updates.
